# Jishnu Mukhoti

> Head of Technology at Finster AI, leading the company's AI and technology strategy. Previously AI Lead on Finster's founding team, and before that a DPhil (PhD) in Machine Learning at the University of Oxford researching methods to safely scale modern neural networks.

Jishnu builds and leads teams building AI systems for decisions where confidence has to be earned, not assumed — currently applied to AI agents for financial research and analysis at Finster AI (https://finster.ai), deployed at global financial institutions including UBS and inside FactSet's AI for Banking.
